22/G.goal: Explain the AR software landscape by identifying its main categories and the representative tools and practical characteristics associated with each category.
22/G.achieves: This supports the learner in choosing suitable AR tools for software development in the course's XR system case study.

22/O1.goal: Explain how AR software is organized into rapid prototyping, plugin-to-existing-tools, and standalone authoring categories, and describe the representative tools and practical characteristics of each category.
22/O1.achieves: This gives the learner a basis for comparing and selecting AR software when planning and building an AR system.
